subject: SkyBridge accelerator: request for extra credits and short trial extension
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@skybridge.vc>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: accelerator cohort - extra credits & short extension

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — SkyBridge loved the latency profile. We have one of our cohort companies (Bayframe Labs) that is hitting token limits in the middle of their integration sprint and is due to present at our demo day on Nov 28. They signed up last month and burned through the trial faster than expected running multi-shot synthesis and embedding pipelines.

Is there any flexibility to (a) grant a one-time top-up of usage credits (we're thinking ~50k tokens equivalent), and (b) extend their trial window by two weeks so they can finish the integration checks before demo day?

I attached a short cohort summary (Skybridge_Cohort_Summary.pdf) with the company profile and expected usage. This is part of a larger batch we may direct into your pilot program next quarter, so we'd like to make the onboarding smooth.

Quick answers appreciated — we have the internal program checklist due Monday.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Accelerator Partnerships
SkyBridge Ventures
Attachment: Skybridge_Cohort_Summary.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@skybridge.vc>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator cohort - extra credits & short extension

Alex — thanks for the note and the summary.

A few quick clarifying questions so we can move this fast:
- Which account (company name/email) is Bayframe using on Redwood?
- Approx monthly token consumption to date and expected peak during the next two weeks?
- Is the ask strictly for hosted API credits, or do they need Dedicated/Private reservations?

I looped Karthik (partnerships) to confirm program-level approvals and to Monica (ops) shortly after — putting Karthik on the ask for a provisional credit approval and Monica for the activation flow. If you can share the Bayframe invoice contact and legal point (or a signed MOU), we can provisionally set aside credits while legal does a quick MOU.

We aim to avoid a full procurement loop for accelerator cohorts, so if the cohort sponsor confirms the relationship and expected spend profile, we can usually issue a conditional top-up + trial extension.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@skybridge.vc>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator cohort - extra credits & short extension

Looping in my thoughts — thanks for surfacing this, Dylan.

We can approve a provisional 50k token-equivalent credit for Bayframe, conditional on two items:
1) Bayframe signs the standard MOU for accelerator cohorts (1-page, outlines credit cap and reporting).
2) Bayframe provides a short spike plan (expected peak requests/day and a quick call with infra engineer) so we can ensure no QoS impact on tenants.

Proposed operational window: extend trial to 2026-12-15 (gives them through demo day and a short post-demo follow-up). If they meet the integration milestones (demo + basic integration checklist), we can consider a follow-on pilot allocation.

Dylan — can Monica handle activation (credit code & dashboard access)? Monica, please confirm if hosted-only is the constraint or whether we need to upsell Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput.

-Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Cc: Bayframe Labs <ops@bayframe.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator cohort - extra credits & short extension

Thanks Karthik — that sounds reasonable. Bayframe (ops@bayframe.ai) confirms they're happy with the MOU and the conditional window. Their CTO (Priya Shah) is available for a brief call tomorrow to share peak shapes.

Couple quick clarifications:
- Can the provisional credit be used against both generation and embedding calls?
- The company is on hosted; no Dedicated required for now.
- Attached: "Skybridge_Technical_Requirements.xlsx" with the expected RPS and token distribution.

If you're good with hosted-only and the MOU, we can have Priya sign and send it back today.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
Attachment: Skybridge_Technical_Requirements.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@skybridge.vc>, Bayframe Labs <ops@bayframe.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator cohort - extra credits & short extension

Hi Alex / Priya,

All set — we will provision a hosted-only credit allocation tied to Bayframe's Redwood account once we receive the signed MOU. Summary of the activation: 
- Credit amount: 50,000 token-equivalent (applies to both generation and embeddings).
- Expiration: 2026-12-15 (trial extended by ~2 weeks).
- Usage constraints: hosted API only; credits are non-transferable; we will monitor usage and reserve right to throttle if abnormal spike (we will notify sponsor).
- Deal id: RB-20261112-482 — please reference in the MOU.

Next steps for Alex/Priya:
1) Sign MOU: https://docusign.com/SKY-MOU-482 (or reply with signed doc attached MOU-SkyBridge.docx).
2) Send the Redwood account email Bayframe uses for billing/owners.
3) Schedule a 20m infra sync (we have an available slot tomorrow 11/14 at 11:30 PST) so our infra team can confirm rate limits.

I'll issue the credit code and enable cohort dashboard access once the signed MOU and account email are received.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Startup Programs Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MOU-SkyBridge.docx
